defects.description: RSA_padding_add_none reaches memcpy only when flen == tlen. When both are negative, the equality holds and the authority (rsa_none.c:20-35) passes the negated int to memcpy. A C-valid hostile call therefore copies S::MAX bytes.
defects.fix: After the two authority comparisons, an equal negative flen is refused at the existing too-small coordinate (0). Non-negative inputs are unchanged.

defects.class: negative length -> oversized memset plus size_t::MAX copy (authority UB)
defects.description: RSA_padding_check_none checks only flen > tlen. A negative flen with a non-negative tlen makes tlen - flen larger than the destination and hands negated flen to memcpy (rsa_none.c:37-49).
defects.fix: A negative flen is refused at the existing too-large coordinate (-1); the copy and its arithmetic run only for 0 <= flen <= tlen.

defects.class: negative length / wrapping arithmetic -> out-of-bounds writes (authority UB)
defects.description: RSA_padding_add_X931 computes j = tlen - flen - 2 before any check. A negative flen makes j positive and the later header/terminator writes exceed tlen; INT_MIN makes the subtraction itself wrap. The authority (rsa_x931.c:43-77) does the same.
defects.fix: Negative tlen/flen are refused at the existing RSA_X931_56 coordinate before the subtraction; every non-negative input keeps the authority's j and output bytes.

defects.class: sub-minimum block -> out-of-bounds header/trailer reads and size_t::MAX copy (authority UB)
defects.description: RSA_padding_check_X931 reads from[0], then a header and a trailer, then copies flen - 2 bytes. flen 0/1 (with num == flen) reads past the input and, for flen 1, copies -1 as size_t. A negative equal pair is worse. The authority (rsa_x931.c:79-122) has the same fault.
defects.fix: The first refusal now requires flen >= 2 as well as num == flen and a valid header; valid X9.31 blocks (minimum two octets) are unchanged.

defects.class: negative length / wrapping arithmetic -> out-of-bounds memset plus size_t::MAX copy (authority UB)
defects.description: RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_type_1 checks only flen > tlen - 11. A negative flen passes that test and makes j = tlen - 3 - flen exceed the destination, while memcpy receives the negated length; INT_MIN wraps the upper-bound subtraction. The authority (rsa_pk1.c:34-52) has both faults.
defects.fix: Negative tlen/flen are refused at the existing RSA_PK1_38 coordinate before the subtraction; the valid 0 <= flen <= tlen - 11 path is byte-identical.

defects.class: wrapping length arithmetic -> out-of-bounds writes (authority UB)
defects.description: ossl_rsa_padding_add_PKCS1_type_2_ex's upper-bound test computes tlen - RSA_PKCS1_PADDING_SIZE. For tlen INT_MIN that subtraction wraps, the test can pass, and j = tlen - 3 - flen wraps to a large positive memset/copy length.
defects.fix: A negative tlen is refused at the existing too-large coordinate before the subtraction. The authority's flen < 0 refusal (RSA_PK1_135) and all valid inputs are unchanged.

defects.class: negative seed length -> size_t::MAX read (authority UB)
defects.description: PKCS1_MGF1 passes seedlen as usize to EVP_DigestUpdate. A negative seedlen becomes a huge read length; the authority (rsa_oaep.c:350-393) does the same conversion.
defects.fix: A negative seedlen answers -1 before the digest context is allocated. A non-positive len still answers 0 as the authority does.

defects.class: negative label length -> size_t::MAX read (authority UB)
defects.description: Both OAEP bodies pass plen as usize to EVP_Digest; the check body also passed a negative flen through (its existing tlen/flen guard already refused it). The authority (rsa_oaep.c:54-166) does the same conversion.
defects.fix: The check body refuses plen < 0 alongside its tlen/flen/mdlen guard; the add body refuses tlen <= 0, flen < 0 and plen < 0 at the existing RSA_OAEP_99 coordinate before computing emlen. Valid labels are unchanged.
defects.witness: M14 control (add with flen -1 -> 0 and plen -1 -> 0; check with plen -1 -> -1).

defects.class: negative label length -> size_t::MAX HMAC read
defects.description: ossl_rsa_prf passes llen as usize to HMAC_Update. Its only callers pass the constants 7 and 6, so the path was latent rather than reachable; the contract did not state the bound.
defects.fix: The existing length-disagreement guard now also refuses llen < 0. Valid calls are unchanged.
defects.witness: Covered by the type-2 implicit-rejection suite (the function is exercised through its callers).

boundary_control.reason: The negative/minimum-length controls run the repaired entry points with frame-owned buffers, so a missing guard performs the negated-length copy immediately. A deliberate guard-removal mutation was not run because it injects undefined behaviour outside ASan. ASan/Miri on the repaired paths and authority differentials for the refusal divergences remain BOUNDARY gates.

no_defect_found: src/cms/cms_pwri.rs: KEK wrap/unwrap lengths are checked before buffers (inlen >= 2*blocklen, multiple, <= INT_MAX; unwrap's raw[0] bounded by inlen < 4 + n), and the password-recipient allocation/free paths match cms_pwri.c. The Null-password arm is refused before passlen is used. No defect.

src/runtime/bio/mod.rs: BIO_new_ex/create-failure, free-veto reference consumption, free_all's shared-element stop, push/pop link repair and dup_chain's partial-copy teardown match bio_lib.c and the B1/B2 contracts. No defect.

src/x509/v3_pci.rs: policy_grow's realloc ownership, the four failure-arm releases, the file-read retry loop and r2i_pci's err cleanup match v3_pci.c; process_pci_value_err nulls the freed slot so the caller's cleanup cannot double-free. No defect.
src/evp/exchange.rs: the raw derive buffer's plain/cleansed release split, the fetched SKEYMGMT ownership on every arm, and the length-mismatch refusal match exchange.c. No defect.

src/evp/e_aria.rs: GCM/CCM IV allocation, COPY re-pointing and cleanup match e_aria.c; the GCM SET_IV_INV ctrl's arg is the EVP_CIPHER ctrl contract's explicit-IV length and is left as authority parity, as in the M7 e_aes audit.
src/encoder_meth.rs: the four-clause provider-function sanity test is transcribed exactly (including its OR shape), and the encoder/context destructors release only their members. No defect.
src/crmf/crmf_asn.rs: item templates and the thin new/free/dup/d2i/i2d wrappers forward the ASN.1 contract; the Sync statics are const-built. No defect.
residuals: RSA padding negative-length refusals now raise the authority's existing error coordinates for inputs that were undefined behaviour there; the error reason for some negative combinations is therefore an intentional divergence.

e_aria's legacy EVP_CTRL_GCM_SET_IV_INV keeps the authority's unchecked arg length; the callback is engine-reachable only and the EVP_CIPHER ctrl contract owns that argument, matching the M7 e_aes result.

cms_pwri's kek_wrap_key reads input[0..3] for a block length of 1 only if a registered KEK cipher had a 0-2 byte key and block size 1; no such cipher exists in the tree, and the authority has the same shape.
src/property/store.rs, src/provider/activate.rs and src/context/namemap.rs remain BOUNDARY (locks/callbacks/refcounts).
